profile_text:
Role: CS master's student (F-1 international), graduating May 2027.
Goals: land a Summer 2027 ML or backend internship or a new-grad ML/backend role; finish thesis.
Urgent: interview scheduling, recruiter or offer deadlines, online assessments about to expire, thesis/advisor deadlines, CPT/OPT paperwork.
Important: application status updates, referrals, advisor feedback, TA duties, class/capstone project changes.
Ignore: retail promotions, sales, crypto, generic newsletters.
Job targets: machine learning engineer, data science, backend software engineer; internship or new grad / entry level; Python, PyTorch, Go, SQL, Kubernetes; Bay Area or Remote.
Dealbreakers: needs visa sponsorship; no security clearance or US-citizens-only roles; no roles requiring 3+ years of experience.
Key senders: thesis advisor, graduate admissions office, recruiters, project teammates.
